summary: Packaged travel reaches Arena readiness. GameBuild07 displays only the New HUD; F3 opens and grant-three feedback was observed. The complete updated Windows payload is now archived and CRC/hash verified. Full Cold and two-account gameplay remain unverified.

environment.test_mode: Packaged local run with -nosteam, -MCHubTransientProfile, isolated E: UserDir and one participant
environment.content_scope: Existing cooked Spacewar resources reused with the rebuilt native runtime; this correction did not require a new asset cook.

changelog: Rebind the canonical destination-world local controller before active/ready preparation early returns; invalidate owner-dependent UI, render readiness and streaming certificates while retaining loaded resources and load identity.
Recreate retained New UI roots when their owner/world/viewport identity is no longer valid after travel; explicit Retry resolves the current local controller.
Defer optional early UI construction while MoviePlayer is active, avoiding the observed concurrent Slate access path.
Select New UI by default and migrate the former default preference once; retained source HUD/Hub artwork stays suppressed in New, including construction before first paint.

During location preparation only, read back the existing cooked GPU morph buffer once per cached world/appearance and decode its bounded batches with the public engine codec; fatal pose capture uses the retained CPU cache.

findings.cause: Seamless travel replaced the weakly held controller. BeginPreparation returned while already preparing before rebinding it, leaving UI preparation with controller=None.

before.result: Unified UI root creation failed after 1446/1446 assets loaded.

findings.before_detail: MTAccessDetector ensure with UMCUIPresentationSubsystem::PrepareInterface/AddToViewport on the game thread and FSlateLoadingSynchronizationMechanism on the loading thread.
findings.limitation: The matching MTAccessDetector/Slate-loading race did not recur in these runs. Two observations do not establish exhaustive race freedom.

findings.cause: Desktop cooking retains the GPU morph stream while the original morph delta count can remain nonzero and the CPU iterator yields no deltas. The engine empties transient CPU GPU-upload data after InitRHI. A CPU-access flag or ordinary Windows recook does not restore this iterator payload.
findings.before_marker: Resident cooked morph data is incomplete; no deferred decompression at fatal use.
findings.review: Independent source review checked per-batch absolute offsets, tangent initialization, zero-batch targets, custom-codec rejection, bounded decoding, integer spans, target order, render-thread lifetime, GPU synchronization and preparation-only gating.

findings.detail: Selecting another mirror backend incorrectly restored previous Current HUD artwork in New. All retained sources now stay suppressed until explicit Current; NativeConstruct also applies suppression. The final actual Arena screenshot contains only New HUD elements.

verified_ready_route.limitation: Readiness and gameplay-start markers prove this local route crossed the real barrier. They do not prove the full run, Cold event, F3 tools, multiplayer or visual acceptance.

builds.detail: C3535/C2440: const auto* could not be deduced from TObjectPtr<UMorphTarget>; no runtime result claimed for this failed build.

resource_readiness_limitations: The verified run logged graphics PSO misses and a 100 ms PSO creation wait during Arena loading before MC_PRELOAD_READY.
A clean first launch with cold driver/PSO caches and first visible Cold/Freeze usage has not been certified by this report.
not_verified: Absence of every legacy startup/travel flash across all transitions
Complete gameplay route from start through the Cold event
Actual Freeze death motion and visual parity after the cooked morph fix
Individual F3 weapon equip/use and remote-team grants
Steam/Spacewar two-account joining, readiness and gameplay

preservation.report_author_scope: Only this JSON report was authored in the checkout by this reporting step; no assets, source, builds, application state, processes or Git state were changed.
preservation.media_policy: Evidence media remains on E: and is linked only; no media is included by this JSON report.

f3_observation.limitation: Individual equip/use and Cold interaction were not completed; Computer Use was stopped by physical Escape.

limits: Archive integrity is not a full Cold gameplay or two-account Steam test.
